verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports scripted test cases, which can be AI-generated. Its CLI runs those tests with JUnit reports, and it can import OpenAPI definitions, so a team could hand-write assertions against live responses to approximate drift detection. Nothing shows responses being validated automatically against the OpenAPI or schema contract itself. Missing for 10: automatic schema/contract validation of responses against an imported OpenAPI spec, drift detection or reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
